title: Let the flower vary
alt_text: Two flower studies contrast a memory-based flower with identical petals and a straight stem against an imperfect observed flower with a tilted axis, unequal petals, checked width, and asymmetric leaves.
caption: Repeated symbols hide the measurements that make this flower particular.
